name: A character with a point of view
art: Use the original character asset named by site/js/expansion/editorial.js as implementation evidence; create a distinct authorized character if adapting the design for another brand.

properties.label: Character-anchored closing page
properties.text: Anchor a warm closing page with one oversized friendly character, balanced by large editorial words, generous open space and compact useful next actions rather than decorative cards.

properties.label: Humane serif with clear controls
properties.text: Mix humane serif emphasis with clear sans controls, keeping the closing words spacious and the actions concise.

properties.label: Cream, olive and muted red
properties.text: Use cream, olive and muted red accents, keeping the interface quiet enough for the illustrated character to carry the color.

properties.label: Sculptural character with point of view
properties.text: Create an original character with rounded volumes, deliberate pose and tiny face and edge details; personality must come from proportion and posture rather than an emoji-like blob.

properties.label: Grounded tactile character
properties.text: Give the character tactile modeled surfaces and a soft contact shadow that places it on the page rather than inside a card.

properties.label: Asset-only character motion
properties.text: If the character moves, preserve its silhouette and keep all reading text still; a one-way state change plays once and holds rather than jumping back into a loop.

properties.label: Honest closing actions
properties.text: Let closing actions download a starting brief or copy an install command, and report each result accurately beside its control.

properties.label: Character personality acceptance
properties.text: Verify that pose, proportion and small details preserve the character's point of view at both phone and desktop scale.
